LKH3AVUpscale.description: Spatially upscales the video part of the packed AV latent for the HD second pass; audio and layout metadata pass through unchanged. Chain: long video sampler av_latent -> this node -> long video sampler refine_latent.

av_latent.name: av_latent
av_latent.tooltip: Packed AV latent from the long video sampler's av_latent output.

upscale_method.name: upscale method
upscale_method.tooltip: Interpolation applied to the video latent (and its mask).

scale_by.name: scale by
scale_by.tooltip: Spatial scale factor. The default 2.0 takes the 0.5MP base canvas to the H3 trained maximum (~1920x1088). The second pass costs roughly scale^2 more compute per token than the first pass.

upscale_in_segments.name: Upscale in segments
upscale_in_segments.tooltip: Upscale one layout segment (per shot) at a time to bound the VRAM peak on long videos. Chunks are temporal, non-overlapping and the interpolation is frame-local, so the assembled result is identical to a whole-tensor upscale.

0.name: av_latent
0.tooltip: Upscaled packed AV latent; feed the downstream HD sampler chain (双钟采样 + BasicGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced).

LKH3Shot.description: One long-video shot: duration, prompt, first/last frame and reference media sockets. Output connects to the MiniMaxH3 Shot Merger node.

0.name: shot
0.tooltip: Connect to a MiniMaxH3 Shot Merger slot (shots 1-8).

LKH3AVDecode.description: Decodes the packed AV latent into frames and audio; also exposes the split video/audio latent halves for custom downstream chains.

av_latent.name: AV Latent
av_latent.tooltip: Nested AV latent from the long-video sampler (or a downstream sampler chain).

video_vae.name: Video VAE
video_vae.tooltip: Video VAE (link from the MiniMaxH3 长视频编排 node).

audio_vae.name: Audio VAE
audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE (link from the MiniMaxH3 长视频编排 node).

LKH3SegmentGuider.description: T8-style GUIDER for the first pass: owns the segmented loop and emits its own matching SAMPLER/SIGMAS - one source of truth for the first-pass recipe.

seed_policy.name: 分段种子策略
seed_policy.tooltip: Per-shot seed split of the base seed from the noise primitive.

context_noise.name: Context noise
context_noise.tooltip: 接缝处对续接上下文帧加噪。0 完全保留上一镜尾帧。

release_clip.name: 分段间释放文本编码器

0.name: GUIDER
0.tooltip: Segmented guider object - wire into SamplerCustomAdvanced's guider.

1.name: sampler

2.name: sigmas

LKH3RefineSegments.description: Segmented HD second pass: refines the upscaled whole-film latent one shot at a time.

LKH3ReferenceFocus.description: Preprocesses a reference photo: face detection, tight identity crops, identity sheet packing.

LKH3Composer.description: One-stop long-video composer: whole-film prompt, model selection, shot collection, and the empty-AV template in one node.

range_end.name: Range End
range_end.tooltip: Auto-narrows to the number of connected shots.
